name: Tabi no Nakama Tai Yuusha no Tamago
source:
"I, the magic warrior, will defeat all monsters in my path!"
...
"Aaaaaiiiiii! I'm going to be the slave of a succubus nurse!"

First there was Princess Doll vs. Hero, then there was JK Robot vs. Company Man.
Now, Somme Works presents the 3rd clash of good and evil (?) with Travelers vs. Hero Egg,
a game of endurance against a seductress by the name of Panstonas.
The protagonist is level up his monster-slaying power with the help of a party.
At that time, a succubus appears to feed on his essence. .
She dazzles him with exquisite sex dreams but drains his XP points when he cums.
The hero's armor and powers are weakened little by little. Oh no!

Yet if he doesn't have those dreams, his sexual desire and cum will build...
and build... and when it reaches a certain amount, he's commit real world transgressions.

Will you achieve a party?
Will fall victim to the succubus? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE136190.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我是魔法战士，要消灭挡在路上的所有怪物！”
……
“啊啊啊啊！我要成为魅魔护士的奴隶了！”

先前有《人偶公主VS勇者》和《女高中生机器人VS上班族》，现在Somme Works带来第三场善恶（？）对决——《旅行者VS勇者蛋》。这是一场与名为潘斯托娜的诱惑者较量耐力的游戏。

主人公在队伍伙伴的帮助下提升讨伐怪物的力量。就在这时，魅魔出现了，要吸取他的精气。

她用精妙的色情梦境迷惑英雄，却在他射精时夺走经验值。英雄的铠甲和力量一点一点变弱。糟糕！

可是，如果不做那些梦，他的性欲和精液就会不断积累……不断积累……达到一定程度后，他就会在现实中做出越轨行为。

你能组建一支队伍吗？
你会成为魅魔的猎物吗？
